pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HOW MUCH LONGER WILL THAT MAN BE HERE...?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I WOULD BE GRATEFUL IF HE LEFT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WE CANNOT ALLOW SOMEONE WHO HAS SLAIN SO MANY MEN TO STAY HERE FOR FOREVER.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: MUSTN'T WE, AS FOLLOWERS OF BUDDHA,

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: NO, ESPECIALLY BECAUSE HE IS A CRIMINAL?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IMPATIENCE WON'T GET YOU WALKING AGAIN.
